description_en: Modifies the Source Network Address Translation (SNAT) configuration of the WAN port on an SCG5000 or SCG5000-5G device whose version is 3.4.2 or later
description_zh: 修改SAG设备WAN口的SNAT配置，适用于设备类型为SCG5000或SCG5000-5G的智能接入网关实例，且设备版本为3.4.2及以上
kebab_example: aliyun smartag update-smart-access-gateway-wan-snat --sag-ins-id sag-jwbtsyzom0ol4v0000 --sag-sn sagf4dk0000 --snat 0 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateSmartAccessGatewayWanSnat

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
parameters.name: sag_ins_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG device
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: sag_sn

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable SNAT. Valid values:

1: enables SNAT
0: disables SNAT
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启SNAT功能。

1：SNAT功能开启。
0：SNAT功能未开启
parameters.name: snat

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the SAG instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only the SAG instances that belong to another Alibaba Cloud account. Valid values:

false (default)
true
parameters.help_zh:
是否只查询跨账号所属的智能接入网关实例。取值：

false（默认值）：否。

true：是
parameters.name: cross_account

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the SAG instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: resource_uid

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates that the task is successful
Code.description_zh: 响应码。200标识查询任务成功

Message.description_en: The response message. A value of Successful indicates that the task is successful
Message.description_zh: 响应消息。Successful标识查询任务成功

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
修改是否成功。取值：
 
true：是。

false：否
